description: This file provides utility functions to initialize and integrate the Preline UI components into a React web application. It allows safe dynamic importation of Preline's compiled JavaScript bundle and offers a React hook to trigger initialization on component mount or dependency updates.

methods.name: initPreline()
methods.description: Asynchronously imports the Preline library and initializes its DOM behaviors, either by calling the official autoInit method or dispatching a DOMContentLoaded event as a fallback.

methods.name: usePreline(deps = [])
methods.description: A React hook that runs the initPreline function whenever the component mounts or dependencies change, facilitating reactive UI component initialization.
